summary: Frontend e2e testing of car self-drive rental (P1 vertical, iter289). All critical user + admin flows pass with deposit=0 short-circuit (Stripe skipped per instructions). Tested fleet listing, booking with dates/quote/docs, license approval, pickup inspection with 2+ photos gating, deposit-less pickup confirmation, admin closure with 2+ return photos + damage fees field. Mirror parity with iter288 moto self-drive confirmed.
critical_code_review_comments: RideChoosePage car-selfdrive-link entry point couldn't be auto-reached via direct URL '/course?mode=location' (app redirects to default Taxi VTC course standard). Code review confirms the link exists with correct data-testid and onClick navigation, but a smoke check via UI would require selecting rental mode + non-moto vehicle through the actual SuperApp home picker. Non-blocking; main agent can self-verify if needed.
Frontend uses correct REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL via carRentalAPI service. No hardcoded URLs found.

All required data-testid attributes are present on interactive elements (car-card-*, car-book, car-start/end, car-quote, car-license-input, car-id-input, car-confirm-btn, car-done, car-mine-list, car-pickup-inspect-*, car-pickup-input-*, car-pickup-validate-*, car-pay-deposit-*, car-add-toggle, car-create-form, car-create-save, car-form-name/ppd/deposit, car-ppd-*, car-save-*, car-approve-*, car-reject-*, car-return-input-*, car-close-*, car-damage-*, admin-car-fleet-tab, admin-car-rentals-tab).
seed_data_creation: Created admin car 'TEST_AUTO_<ts>' with deposit=0 to bypass Stripe; created one rental crent_* for paul.vendeur, drove it to 'returned' status (license approved → pickup photos uploaded → confirmer le retrait → admin closed with 2 return photos + 0 damages).

car-quote computes live on date entry

car-selfdrive-link from /course UI (verified by code inspection only; direct URL did not enter rental mode in this run)
Backend testing (per request 'frontend only(skip backend)'; iter289 pytest already 6/6 PASS)
